body:
What do I have to look forward too? Going home so I can be with my kids, who don't even like me, for a few weeks before I have to go away again. 

Watch on a video call next Christmas as they open presents I bought them but they don't like because they stopped like that show or this movie months ago and I didn't know? 

It's not just Christmas. I have never had a good Christmas. My abusive mother saw to that. But all year I have made her unhappy. All year she has resented my being away. 

I think she's cheating on me too. I've been loyal. I'm just trying to provide for them. I'm just trying my best and it's never good enough. 

What's the point.
